text_block_list.text:
One day, Tamamo Cross invited me to an 
okonomiyaki party. On our way back after 
buying the ingredients—

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Man
text_block_list.text:
Um... look here, kid, I'll make you 
taiyaki another time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Mister! Is something wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ah... Did you drop your precious 
taiyaki on the ground? Aw, that's rough...

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... My taiyaki...

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Man
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love to make a new one for ya, but 
I've run plumb out of fabric..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll make some taiyaki! So, could ya 
lend me the equipment for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Man
text_block_list.text: No, but the ingredients—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, leave it to me! I've got a 
secret plan up my sleeve!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't have it, just make it!" 
That's the ironclad rule in our house!!

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Man
text_block_list.text:
Well now, makin' taiyaki out of 
okonomiyaki batter... That's quite clever 
of you, little lady.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what I call a handy life hack! 
Ooh, it's about time to flip it over!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Got it—hiya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Now that's grilled to 
perfection! You've got some real talent 
for this~!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: You think so? Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, all done! Come on, everyone, 
eat up, eat up!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch*... *gulp*!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think? The taste and texture might 
be a bit different, but it still gives ya 
that taiyaki feeling, right?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Both the crust and the red bean 
paste are super delicious!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Get it now, kid? With a little ingenuity, 
you can work through pretty much anything!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If there's somethin' ya want, don't give 
up! Standin' around cryin' is just a waste 
o' time!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Big sis... Got it, thank you!
choice_data_list: That's our big sister for you!
That's our big sister for you!

Now I'm in the mood for something savory 
too.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Big sis... Got it, thank you!
choice_data_list: That's our big sister for you!
That's our big sister for you!

Now I'm in the mood for something savory 
too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Well, ya can leave lookin' after 
the kids to me!

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Man
text_block_list.text:
You were a real lifesaver, little lady! 
Man, you're so impressive despite being so 
small!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wha...?! You didn't have to add "tiny", ya 
hear?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Damn it! Someday, I'm definitely gonna 
become a huge, legendary Umamusume!

Tamamo Cross's heartfelt cry echoed all 
across the area.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right! This is fine and all, but I 
wanna eat some proper okonomiyaki too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"We've still got plenty of ingredients 
left, so once we get back, I'll treat you 
to heaps of authentic okonomiyaki!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, take care, kiddo and mister! I'll 
come buy some taiyaki next time~!

And after returning to the academy, I 
enjoyed some delicious okonomiyaki with 
Tamamo Cross.
